fields.description: Choose whether checkout creates Sales Invoice or POS Invoice. ZATCA/e-invoicing behaviour is configured in ZATCA settings when that app is installed.
fields.label: Invoice Posting Type

fields.description: SMS OTP for customer booking is optional. Enable when an SMS provider is configured.
fields.label: Enable SMS OTP

fields.description: Send one-time verification codes by email when the customer provides an email address.
fields.label: Enable Email OTP

fields.description: Email customers a booking confirmation with check-in QR code when an appointment is confirmed.
fields.label: Send Booking Confirmation Email

fields.description: Optional sender address for booking emails. Leave blank to use the site default outgoing email.
fields.label: Booking From Email

fields.description: How long the OTP remains valid after it is sent.
fields.label: OTP Expiry (Minutes)

fields.description: Maximum verification attempts allowed per OTP request.
fields.label: OTP Max Attempts

fields.description: When enabled, customers must pay online before the appointment is confirmed.
fields.label: Require Payment at Booking

fields.description: When enabled, reception/beautician cannot start or complete a service until payment is collected (Cash at reception/kiosk or POS). Check-in only confirms arrival.
fields.label: Require Payment Before Service

fields.description: When enabled, the self-service kiosk collects payment (cash/card modes allowed for kiosk) before the booking is confirmed.
fields.label: Require Payment at Kiosk

fields.description: When enabled, reception and beauticians must scan the customer's appointment QR code before check-in. Prevents checking in the wrong guest by mistake.
fields.label: Require QR Scan for Check-in

fields.description: Only flagged Mode of Payment rows are offered in Beauty Cloud channels. Third-party payment API integration will use these modes later.
fields.label: Allowed Payment Methods

fields.description: Enable Telr hosted payment page for online booking checkout.
fields.label: Enable Telr Gateway

fields.description: Numeric store ID from Telr merchant dashboard.
fields.label: Telr Store ID

fields.description: When enabled, no live Telr API calls are made. Use demo payment buttons in the booking UI.
fields.label: Telr Demo Mode

fields.default: Install and configure zatca_erpgulf on this site for Saudi e-invoicing. Invoice document type above must align with ZATCA settings.
fields.label: ZATCA Note
